ui.home.aboutText: WFTools brings together small tools you use every day in one place. Everything runs on your own device: nothing to install, no account needed, and what you enter is never sent anywhere. New tools are added over time.

home.title: WFTools — Free Online Tools
home.metaDescription: Free online tools: QR & barcode generator, image compress & convert, PDF merge/split, JSON/XML/CSV/Excel converter, salary, loan, BMI, timetable, countdown and more. Runs in your browser, no sign-up.
home.lead: Pick a tool and use it right in your browser. No sign-up, and your data never leaves your device.
home.keywords: online tools, free tools, QR code generator, barcode generator, image compressor, PDF tools, file converter, salary calculator, BMI, web utilities

bmi-bmr.desc: Calculate body mass index (BMI), waist-hip ratio and calorie needs (BMR, TDEE) by age, sex and activity level.

meal-calo.desc: Plan meals by a calorie goal, look up calories of common dishes and balance protein, carbs and fat.

study-timetable.name: Study Timetable

mindmap.name: Mind Map & Summary
mindmap.desc: Draw mind maps for lessons and automatically summarize long text into key points.

teaching-pay.name: Teaching Hours & Pay
teaching-pay.desc: Log teaching sessions, total the hours and pay by rate, and export a statement.

fullscreen-clock.name: Fullscreen Clock
fullscreen-clock.desc: A large fullscreen digital clock with stopwatch and countdown, customizable colors, font and 12/24-hour format.

countdown-video.name: Countdown Video Maker
countdown-video.desc: Create a customizable countdown timer and download it as a video to drop into your clips.

world-clock.name: World Clock
world-clock.desc: See the current time in many countries at once and compare time-zone differences between them.

workdays.name: Working Days Calculator
workdays.desc: Count the working days between two dates, excluding Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays.

journal.name: Online Journal
journal.desc: Write a daily journal saved privately to your own Google Sheet, readable only by you.

code-format.name: Format JS, HTML, CSS, JSON
code-format.desc: Neatly indent and tidy up JavaScript, HTML, CSS and JSON code.

code-check.name: Syntax Checker
code-check.desc: Find syntax and structure errors in JavaScript, HTML, CSS and JSON, with line and column.

js-obfuscate.name: JavaScript Obfuscator
js-obfuscate.desc: Encode strings, rename variables and obfuscate JavaScript to make it hard to read and copy.

text-to-html.name: Rich Text to HTML
text-to-html.desc: Edit visually with bold, headings, lists, tables and links, and get clean HTML code.

inventory.desc: Set selling prices from marketplace fees, ads and margin. Track stock in and out with low-stock alerts.

invoice.name: Invoice & Quote
invoice.desc: Create quotes and sales invoices with a logo, auto totals and amount in words. Print or save as PDF.

menu-qr.name: QR Menu

barcode.name: Barcode Generator
barcode.desc: Generate Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A and Code 39 barcodes for product and warehouse labels.

loan.name: Loan Calculator
loan.desc: Monthly payment, total interest and a repayment schedule for home, car and consumer loans.

compound.name: Compound Interest & Savings
compound.desc: Project how much you accumulate with regular monthly savings or investments.

salary.name: Gross ↔ Net Salary
salary.desc: Convert Gross to Net salary and back, following 2026 insurance and personal income tax rules (Vietnam).

qr-code.name: QR Code Generator
qr-code.desc: Create QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi, email and phone numbers. Download as PNG or SVG.

utm.name: UTM Link Builder
utm.desc: Add campaign tracking codes to links to see which channel your visitors come from.

colors.name: Color Palette & Codes
colors.desc: Build a harmonious palette from a base color and get HEX, RGB, HSL codes and CSS variables.

expense.name: Expense & Budget
expense.desc: Log daily income and expenses, view spending by category and set limits to stay on budget.

habit.name: Habit & Streak Tracker
habit.desc: Mark habits each day and track consecutive-day streaks to stay disciplined.

rsa-keys.pubPh: Click "Generate new key pair" or paste a public key in PEM (-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----) here, then click "Use pasted key pair".
rsa-keys.privPh: Private key in PEM (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----). This key is required to decrypt.
rsa-keys.status.none: Generate or paste a key pair above. A public key lets you encrypt; a private key lets you decrypt.
rsa-keys.plainPh: Type text here; the encrypted string appears on the right.
rsa-keys.cipherPh: Or paste an encrypted string here to decrypt it to text.
rsa-keys.note: Everything runs in your browser via Web Crypto and is never sent anywhere. Because RSA can only encrypt very short data directly, the tool uses hybrid encryption: it generates a random AES key to encrypt the text, then wraps that AES key with RSA — so text of any length can be encrypted. The recipient needs the matching private key to decrypt. The public key (SPKI) can be shared; the private key (PKCS#8) must be kept secret.
rsa-keys.status.ready: Ready: type text to encrypt, or paste an encrypted string to decrypt.
rsa-keys.status.pubOnly: Public key present: can encrypt. No private key, so cannot decrypt yet.
rsa-keys.status.privOnly: Private key present: can decrypt. No public key, so cannot encrypt yet.
rsa-keys.err.genHint: The browser must support Web Crypto (use a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari).
rsa-keys.err.pastePem: Paste a public or private key in PEM into the box above.
rsa-keys.err.pubRead: Could not read the public key. It needs the correct public PEM format (-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----, SPKI).
rsa-keys.err.privRead: Could not read the private key. It needs the correct private PEM format (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----, PKCS#8).
rsa-keys.status.noPub: No public key, so cannot encrypt. Generate or paste a public key.
rsa-keys.status.noPriv: No private key, so cannot decrypt. Paste the matching private key.
rsa-keys.status.badFormat: The encrypted string is not in this tool's format.
rsa-keys.status.decErr: Could not decrypt: wrong private key, or the encrypted string was modified or truncated.

text-analysis.drop.title: Choose a TXT, Word (.docx), PDF file or drag & drop
text-analysis.drop.hint: File under 30 MB. PDF must have a text layer (not a scan).
text-analysis.skipStop: Skip common words (and, the, of, is…)
text-analysis.note: Density = occurrences × words in the phrase ÷ total words. For SEO articles the main keyword is usually 1–3%; too high looks like keyword stuffing. Vietnamese is counted by syllable like Microsoft Word, so "cà phê" is 2 words — check the 2-word and 3-word tabs for meaningful phrases.
text-analysis.hint.long: Sentences are quite long; readers may struggle. Break up sentences over 25 words.
text-analysis.hint.good: Sentence length is easy to read.
text-analysis.kwInvalid: The keyword must contain letters or numbers.
text-analysis.lv.low: A bit low, you could mention it more.
text-analysis.err.tooLong: Text is too long (over 5 million characters).
text-analysis.sample:
Iced milk coffee is a familiar drink for people all over the world. Every morning, millions of people start their day with a rich, refreshing glass of iced milk coffee.

To make good iced milk coffee, you need freshly ground coffee, milk and plenty of ice. The coffee is brewed slowly, drip by drip, for about five minutes.

Today, iced milk coffee is loved by friends from many countries and appears on the menu of cafes around the world.
